description:
Rewrite the storage-record reference prose and the `GateRunResult` rustdoc so they describe per-issue run records instead of the flat layout's rationale.

## Background

The generated storage-record reference explains that "`gate-runs/` is flat rather than nested per issue" (`crates/jit/src/storage/reference.rs:184-188,549-556`, rendered into `docs/reference/storage-records.md:60-65,126`), and the `GateRunResult` rustdoc names `gate-runs/<run-id>/result.json` (`domain/types.rs:923-929`). Runs are stored at `gate-runs/<issue-id>/<run-id>.json`, and an issue's history is one directory listing.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The reference source and the `GateRunResult` rustdoc describe `gate-runs/<issue-id>/<run-id>.json` and the per-issue history listing, with no flat-layout rationale.
- [hard] REQ-02: The committed reference is regenerated and matches the projection.

## Notes

- Written against the code as it stands after the semantic-types epic (2195c98f): issue ids are `IssueId`, gate-run ids `GateRunId`, gate keys `GateKey`, lease ids `LeaseId`, events are an `Event` envelope around a tagged `EventBody`, and record paths come from `VirtualPath` constructors. Line citations name current code, which that epic retypes.
title: Gate-run layout prose describes per-issue records
